title: 社交场合

sentenceFrames.pattern: ：How do you know [host / person]? / What brings you here?
sentenceFrames.usage: 社交场合最好的开场白。自然、不生硬、给了对方说话的方向。
sentenceFrames.example: So how do you know David? / What brings you to this event?
substitutions: 在一个朋友组织的聚会上认识新朋友：So how do you know _____?
在一个行业活动上：What brings you to this conference?
在一个婚礼上：Are you on the bride's side or the groom's side?
你的版本：So _____? / What brings you _____?

sentenceFrames.pattern: ：That reminds me of [story / thought]. / Speaking of [topic], [related point].
sentenceFrames.usage: 顺着话题延展，不让对话死掉。这是社交高手的核心技巧。
sentenceFrames.example: That reminds me of a place I went to in Chengdu — the food was incredible, but I couldn't handle the spice. / Speaking of travel, have you been anywhere interesting lately?
substitutions: 对方说"我很喜欢做饭" → That reminds me of _____. / Speaking of cooking, _____.
对方说"我最近在找工作" → That reminds me of _____. / Speaking of career changes, _____.
对方说了一个你去过的地方 → That reminds me of _____. / Speaking of _____, _____.
你自己顺着话题延伸：_____. That reminds me of _____. / Speaking of _____, _____.

sentenceFrames.pattern: ：Anyway, [transition]. / I should probably [go / mingle / get another drink]. It was great talking to you!
sentenceFrames.usage: 优雅地结束一段对话。不要突兀地走开，先给一个过渡信号。
sentenceFrames.example: Anyway, I should probably let you grab some food — I've been talking your ear off. It was really great meeting you!
substitutions: Anyway, I should probably **go find my friend — I promised I'd call them.** It was great talking to you!
Anyway, I'm going to **grab another drink.** It was really nice chatting with you!
I don't want to take up your whole evening. I'll let you go mingle. It was great meeting you!
你的优雅退场：Anyway, _____. It was great _____.
